en: Break Time
Devas and asuras, with their crowned heads,
Bow to your lotus feet.
You liberate from every form of destitution.
To you, Mother Tārā, I make this offering.

tr: zhab kyi pemo la tü dé
pongpa kün lé dröl dzé ma
tr_zh: 辣懂喇门觉奔吉
暇记班莫喇堆爹
碰罢根列卓载麻
卓玛永拉洽擦洛

en: O goddess! Life after life, I have devoted my practice to you.
You are the enlightened activity of all buddhas, past, present, and future;
Turquoise colored, with one face and two hands, you are swift, serene, and courageous;
Mother of the buddhas, holder of the utpala flower, to you I make this offering.

tr: dak gi tserab ngön né drubpé lha
düsum sangyé kün gyi trinlé ma
ngojang zhal chik chak nyi nyur zhi pa
yum gyur utpal nam la chöpa bül
tr_zh: 达格 查拉 根度 竹贝拉
度宋 桑杰 根吉 庆列玛
哦姜 夏吉 洽尼 纽兴巴
尤久 乌达 南拉 邱巴布

en: This exquisite food, with a hundred flavors, so perfectly prepared,
I offer with devotion to the victors and their heirs.
By the merit of this offering, may all beings
Come to enjoy the nourishing food of samādhi.

tr: legjar di ni gyalwa sé ché la
jorden tingdzin zé la chöpar shok
tr_zh: 谢赛若加登比以绰巴
列夏迪尼加瓦塞杰拉
德比普为卓瓦迪达根
角登丁真赛拉龙觉巴秀

title.en: A Fifteen-Verse Prayer to the King of the Śākyas

en: When you sat under the great Bodhi Tree and the earth and sky were filled with hordes of māras,
Raining down cascades of vajras, spears, wheels, fire, and entire mountains and glaciers—
Magical displays unleashed by the mighty Flower-Arrowed One striving to avert your awakening—
You defeated them all with nothing but love in your heart and attained perfect buddhahood – to you I bow my head.
zh: 于彼菩提樹王前 魔軍部衆遍天地
金剛短槍輪寶火 羣山雪嶺雨雹翻
具力魔王持花箭 現起神變障正覺
慈心善妙降伏者 正等覺前誠頂禮

tr: gang zhik jangchub shingwang drung du dü dé pung ché sa dang kha la künkhyab ching
dorjé dungtung dang ni khorlo mé dang ri dang gangri trengwé char bebpa
dzutrül nampar trül jé tobden metok da chen jangchub dok chir tsönpa na
jampé tuk kyi legpar pam dzé dzogpé sangyé gang nyé délagö chak tsal
tr_zh: 岗喜香秋兴旺种读堵碟崩界萨档卡啦根治经
多杰董通当尼阔洛梅当日当岗日称为洽北巴
组出南巴出协哆典梅哆达间香秋夺器尊巴拿
蒋比凸吉雷巴磅这作比桑吉岗宁爹啦轨曹擦

rubric.en: In devotion I prostrate to the guru and Mañjughoṣa.

en: When, for the benefit of others
And with perfect intention and application,
You gave rise to the noble resolve to attain supreme awakening,
Even the earth shook in six motions.

tr: khyö kyi zhen gyi dön lé du
sa yang nampa druk tu yö
tr_zh: 雀记贤记敦雷读
嗓当玖瓦喷措贝
香秋党巴凸给测
萨杨南巴竹杜悦

en: You mastered generosity and discipline,
Cultivated forbearance and diligence,
And brought meditation and wisdom to their culmination—
Homage to you, in whom the perfections were complete.

tr: jin dang tsültrim lek drub shing
paröl chin dzok khyö chak tsal
tr_zh: 锦当慈诚雷竹兴
随当尊竹宫巴这
桑殿谢惹塔钦贝
柏若钦昨却曹擦

en: Protector of beings, the moment you were born,
The learned and wise of this world were delighted,
Māras grew deeply concerned,
And all those who proclaimed mistaken paths were terrified.

tr_zh: 卓棍当波丹巴拿
吉定堪巴堂吉噶
读南辛杜朵巴给
模爹杰巴塔达栅

en: And so, the activity of your teaching
Shines forth like the light of the sun;
And being never deceiving in any way,
You are the true friend in whomI take refuge.

tr: dé lé khyö kyi tenpa ni
tsalak khyö la dak kyab chi
tr_zh: 爹雷却记丹巴尼
尼弥威新称列昂
南巴根杜米露为
匝辣却喇达嘉期

en: When your sublime teaching, like the lion’s roar,
Resounded throughout this world with its gods,
Brahmā and Viṣṇu were speechless,
And the teacher of the gods cowered like a fox.

tr: lha yi lama wa tar zhum
tr_zh: 雀记诵惹僧奇贬
喇介吉定眨巴拿
仓当治局故巴久
喇宜喇嘛瓦大途

en: Sages, like Akṣapāda and Vālmīki,
Seers, such as Vyāsa and Vāsiṣṭha,
And many others of great renown —
To you, who disarmed them all with the Dharma, I bow.

tr: chö kyi pam dzé khyö la dü
tr_zh: 荼巴更弥卓卡当
掌索给巴涅玖梭
眨巴透巴爹达根
秋记磅这崔啦堆

en: Having attained supreme awakening,
You accomplished beings’ benefit in the most wondrous ways;
And for as long as you were not yet free from the thirst for existence,
You gave your body and life – this fills me with awe!

tr: khyö kyi jangchub chok nyé né
tr_zh: 雀记香秋邱尼内
卓为敦这哦擦切
寺比寺列玛卓瓦
咕梭东为拔布档

en: Without regard for your own well-being
You proclaimed: “I will benefit you!”,
And so you hold us, who are without protection, in your care.
Protector, in you I take refuge.

tr: gönpo khyö la dak kyab chi
tr_zh: 尼记咕所米实巴
雀啦彭巴夹窝协
衮梅达价婕耸瓦
贡波雀啦达嘉期

en: Victorious One, you tamed the hosts of māras,
Disarmed all those who proclaimed mistaken paths,
Liberated countless śrāvaka disciples,
And bestowed prophecies upon sublime bodhisattvas.

tr_zh: 嘉为 读碟 杜瓦 当
模爹 麻吕 嗙 泽 当
年推 啰玛 掌梅 周
嘉释 旦巴 隆殿 泽

en: Those who perceive such abundance of excellence
Strive to accomplish your sublime qualities;
And so I, who follow the path to awakening,
Once again take refuge in you.

tr: laryang khyö la dak kyab chi
tr_zh: 爹纸 雷措 通瓦 南
雀记 云丹 敦涅 韦
香秋 类读 局巴 大
拉杨 雀啦 大 加基

en: You who made Mañjughoṣa your principal heir,
Śāriputra your foremost disciple,
And Maitreya your sublime regent;
What wise person could ever doubt you!

tr_zh: 崔记 寺尼 蒋比央
啰玛 下惹 达帝补
蒋巴 嘉擦 旦巴这
森谢 素喜 贴村洒

en: What need is there to speak of your sublime qualities,
When just to see those of your heirs is measure enough?
For similarly does the splendor of the breaking dawn
Announce the radiance of the lotus-opening sun.

tr_zh: 雀记云丹媚既擦
寺记 云丹 通为款
迦仍夏为使吉记
贝摩年记威色果

en: Having gained wisdom complete in every aspect—
Knowing the true nature of phenomena as well as their full extent—
All the enlightened deeds you had undertaken,
You accomplished perfectly; to you I pay homage.

tr: drubpa khyö la dak chak tsal
tr_zh: 极大瓦当吉尼秋
雀记南巴 根尼贝
协比 琛列 敦新读
竹巴雀啦 达曹擦

en: Through this praise of the perfect buddha bhagavān,
The teacher of beings from the Śākya clan,
Born into the line of Ikṣvāku,
May all beings swiftly attain omniscience.

tr: drowé künkhyen nyur du tobpar shok
tr_zh: 爹大 卓威 喇嘛 夏迦日
补壤兴比读举列冲巴
窘典 作比 桑吉 队巴宜
卓为根钦纽读透巴咻

rubric_after.en: This prayer in fifteen stanzas to the Bhagavān King of Śākyas was composed by the glorious Sakya Paṇḍita at the Tsuklagkhang in Lhasa. Translated by Christian Bernert.

title.en: A Garland of Utpala Blossoms: The Lineage Prayer for Zaptik Drolchok, the Mind Treasure of Tārā
title.zh: 意伏藏度母传承祈请文·优钵罗鬘

en: Buddha Samantabhadrī, dharmakāya’s Transcendent Wisdom,
Vajravārāhī, sambhogakāya’s total perfection;
Sublime mother Tara, nirmāṇakāya’s magical display;
To you I pray, grant me siddhis, common and supreme!

tr: solwa deb so choktün ngödrub tsol
tr_zh: 曲古谢庆炯丹棍桑莫
隆觉永作班杂瓦拉亥
楚贝南若杰尊卓玛永
索瓦戴索秋屯恩珠衮

en: Padmākara, our ‘second buddha’,
Master of the treasury of secret mantra, lord over a hundred thousand ḍākinīs,
Bodhisattva prince Yeshé Rolpa Tsal,
To you I pray, grant me siddhis, common and supreme!

tr: sang ngak dzö dzin daki bum gyi jé
solwa deb so choktün ngödrub tsol
tr_zh: 桑杰尼巴贝玛嘎拉当
桑阿佐珍达吉本吉杰
香秋森巴拉塞若巴匝
索瓦戴索秋屯恩珠衮

en: Chokgyur Dechen Lingpa, revealer of profound termas;
Dorjé Ziji Tsal, holder of the seven direct blessings;
Pema Garwang, elucidator of the buddhas’ teachings;
To you I pray, grant me siddhis, common and supreme!

tr: kabab dün den dorjé ziji tsal
gyalten sal dzé pema gar gyi wang
solwa deb so choktün ngödrub tsol
tr_zh: 萨代戈杰秋久德钦林
嘎巴敦丹多杰西吉匝
杰丹萨泽贝玛嘎吉旺
索瓦戴索秋屯恩珠衮

en: beró namtrul gyurmé tsewang tsal
kunzig jamyang chökyi lodö and
mindrol tsolzé khyabdak manga lar
To you I pray, grant me siddhis, common and supreme!
zh: 貝若扎那幻化身久美次旺
遍知一切文殊曲吉羅珠尊
賜熟解脫遍主尊者曼嘎拉
祈禱垂賜共與不共勝悉地

tr: solwa deb so choktün ngödrub tsol
tr_zh: 贝瑞楚南久美次旺采
孔锡江扬确吉洛卓当
敏卓左则恰达芒加拉
索瓦戴索秋屯恩珠左

rubric.en: Addition

en: Holders of the treasury of ripening and liberation, vast and profound,
Root and lineage gurus, deities of the Sublime Lady, swift to act,
Infinite gurus, devas and ḍākinīs, with Vajra Dharma protectors,
To you I pray, grant me siddhis, common and supreme!
zh: 根本傳承上師聖速疾尊

tr: tsa gyü lama pakma nyur dzé lha
tsa sum dorjé chösung gyatso la
solwa deb so choktün ngödrub tsol

匝居拉瑪 帕瑪紐傑拉
匝森 多杰 邱松 加措拉
索瓦 爹梭 效屯 欧珠索

rubric.en: Composed by Mangala

en: Let the earth of my mind be soaked in renunciation,
Letting the green shoots of pure altruistic intention sprout and grow,
Their branches laden with the fruits of great primordial wisdom,
That are the benefit of self and others, spontaneously fulfilled!

拉桑 达贝 觉琼 才杜昂

en: Activity expanse of all buddhas united.
OĀryāTārā, Mother of the Victors,
I pray to you with one-pointed devotion:
Grant the supreme and common accomplishments!

tr_zh: 杰坤 杜贝 呈列 因
杰尤 阿日亚 他热玛
则吉 吉贝 索瓦 爹

en: In the sky before me, Noble Tara is present in actuality.
zh: 觀想前方虛空安住至尊度母。如是信解。

rubric.en:
Namo Gurvya aryatarayai!
In honor of Tara, mother to all the guides
And their heirs in all three times—
She who has wonderful resolve and activity—
I set out here the practice according to Kriya and Carya.
Since this Profound Essence is a condensation of every quintessential profundity, it is not necessary to resort to much elaboration. Nevertheless there are two degrees of detail: one slightly elaborate and the other as a daily practice.
For the first, in front of a painting or statue of the noble Lady Tara, or whatever image of the Three Jewels you can acquire, arrange, on a clean surface, the two waters, the general offerings, the round white torma, the cleansing water, the offering mandala, grain for tossing, and other articles. If you can, keep the conduct of bathing and cleanliness. If unable to do that, at least perform the practice when you have not consumed meat or alcohol, such as in the morning. With an attitude of renunciation and bodhicitta, recite these verses of refuge and bodhicitta:

en: Namo. In the Noble Lady, embodiment of all the Three Jewels,
I and all beings take refuge.
Arousing bodhicitta in aspiration,
I will enter the profound path!
zh: 頂禮 三寶總集度母尊

tr: dak sok dro kün kyap su chi
tr_zh: 南木，拿摩棍却棍约杰尊玛
达梭卓棍佳素契
将促闷贝森皆涅
撤摩浪拉究巴吉

rubric_after.en:
Recite three times.
To gather the accumulations, recite:

title.zh: 积集资粮（顶礼、供养、忏悔）

en: To the noble Lady Tara,
And to all the conquerors and their heirs
Who reside in the ten directions and three times,
Sincerely and with delight, I pay homage.

tr: chok chu dü sum zhukpa yi
tr_zh: 杰尊 帕玛卓玛倘
秋究读速修巴宜
佳哇瑟界汤界拉
棍涅达威恰擦洛

en: I offer flowers and incense, lamps and perfume,
Food, music and the like,
Both materially present and mentally created.
May they be accepted by the Noble Lady’s assembly!

tr: ngöjor yi kyi trül né bül
pakmé tsok nam zhé su sol
tr_zh: 美多读布玛美契
暇瑟若摩拉梭巴
约觉宜吉竹涅普
帕美措吉谐速梭

en: Throughout beginningless time until this very day,
I have committed the ten non-virtues and the five without interval.
I apologize for each and every evil deed committed
Under the influence of disturbed states of mind.

tr: mi gé chu dang tsamé nga
tr_zh: 托玛美涅他喋巴
米给究倘粲美雅
森尼虐蒙旺秋贝
迪巴汤界 夏巴吉

en: I rejoice in all merit and goodness
Created throughout the three times
By shravakas, pratyeka-buddhas and bodhisattvas,
By ordinary beings, and all others.

tr: sönam la ni dak yi rang
tr_zh: 念推让佳强秋森
梭梭系喔拉梭贝
读速给哇 吉萨贝
虽南拉尼达宜让

en: In accordance with the capabilities
And individual aspirations of sentient beings,
I ask you to turn the wheel of Dharma
Of the general, greater and lesser vehicles.

tr: chö kyi khorlo kor du sol
tr_zh: 森间南吉桑巴倘
洛宜切叉其大哇
切琼吞梦 帖巴宜
却吉扩洛 郭突梭

en: Until samsara has been emptied,
Do not pass into nirvana, but please, in your compassion,
Care for each and every being
Sinking in the ocean of suffering.

tr: nya ngen mi da tukjé yi
semchen nam la zik su sol
tr_zh: 扩哇 其夕玛东巴
雅恩米达突杰宜
读雅佳措 清哇宜
森间 南拉息速梭

en: May whatever merit I have gathered
Become a cause for enlightenment,
And may I, in the near future,
Become a splendid guide for sentient beings.

tr: drenpé pal du dak gyur chik
tr_zh: 达格 虽南 吉萨巴
汤界 强秋 究秋涅
仁波 米托 卓哇宜
真贝 巴突 达秋吉

tr: om benza amrita kundali hana hana hung pé
tr_zh: 嗡 班雜 阿密達 貢達哩 哈那 哈那 吽呸

tr: om sobhava shuddho sarva dharma sobhava shuddho hang
tr_zh: 嗡 索巴哇 修達 薩哇 達瑪 索巴哇 修多杭

en: Here, in the Realm of Lotus Array,
Perfectly formed and abundantly decorated
There are offerings surpassing thought—
Divine articles created from samadhi.

tr_zh: 涅优 悲摩 皈贝兴
宜倘 间皈 侧美巴
拉则 丁曾 列出贝
却则 桑米 洽巴秋

rubric.en: Thereby cleanse and purify.

tr: om benza argham ah hung. om benza padam ah hung. om benza pushpé ah hung. om benza düpé ah hung. om benza aloké ah hung. om benza gendhé ah hung. om benza naividyé ah hung. om benza shapda ah hung.
tr_zh: 嗡 班雜 剛巴 阿吽。嗡 班雜 當布 阿吽。嗡 班雜 貝都 阿吽。嗡 班雜 貝阿 阿吽。嗡 班雜 洛給根 阿吽。嗡 班雜 喋涅 阿吽。嗡 班雜 威喋 阿吽。嗡 班雜 夏達 阿吽。
嗡班雜薩帕拉拿康

rubric_after.en: Following that, begin with honoring and making offerings to the Three Jewels in general:

title.en: Homage & Offering to the Three Jewels

en: The masters, the conquerors, and their heirs of the ten directions and four times are in the sky before me, vajra-samaja!
zh: 十方四時，一切上師佛菩薩俱臨前方虛空 中班雜薩瑪雜

tr: chok chu dü zhi lama gyelwa sé dang chepa tamché dün gyi namkhar benza sa ma dza
tr_zh: 秋究读息喇嘛 佳哇瑟倘皆巴汤界 敦吉 南 卡班杂萨玛杂

en: Protector of all sentient beings without exception,
Deity who defeats the endless hordes of maras,
Since you are fully omniscient,
Blessed One and your retinue, please approach this place!

tr: malü semchen kün gyi gön gyur ching
dü dé pung ché mi zé jom dzé lha
ngö nam malü jizhin khyen gyurpé
chomden khor ché né dir shek su sol
tr_zh: 玛吕 森间 棍吉 棍秋清
读喋崩界米瑟 炯则拉
诺南玛吕其欣千秋贝
炯殿扩界 涅迪谢速梭
貝瑪嘎瑪拉呀當

rubric_after.en: Next recite the Seven Branch Prayer:

en: To all the buddhas, lions of men,
In all directions of the universe, through past and present and future:
To every single one of you, I bow in homage;
Devotion fills my body, speech, and heart.

tr: ji nyé su dak chok chü jikten na
dü sum shekpa mi yi sengé kün
dak gi malü dé dak tamché la
lü dang ngak yi dangwé chak gyi-o
tr_zh: 吉涅速达 秋具 吉殿拿
都宋谢巴米宜 圣给贡
达给玛吕 喋达 唐界拉
鹿档阿宜档威治寄哦

en: Through the power of this prayer, Aspiring to Good Action,
All the victorious ones appear, vivid before my mind,
And I multiply my body as many times as there are atoms in the universe,
Each one bowing in prostration to all the buddhas.

tr: zangpo chöpé mönlam top dak gi
gyelwa tamché yi kyi ngönsum du
zhing gi dül nyé lü rap tüpa yi
gyelwa kün la rap tu chaktsel lo
tr_zh: 桑波倔贝莫蓝 多达给
加哇唐界宜吉恩宋都
行给独涅吕拉都巴宜
加哇贡拉拉度洽擦罗

en: In every atom preside as many buddhas as there are atoms,
And around them, all their bodhisattva heirs,
And so I imagine them filling completely
The entire space of reality.

tr: dül chik teng na dül nyé sangyé nam
sangyé sé kyi ü na zhukpa dak
dé tar chö kyi ying nam malüpa
tamché gyelwa dak gi gangwar mö
tr_zh: 都季定拿都涅 桑杰南
桑杰色及悟拿 淑巴达
喋大却吉 映南玛吕巴
趟界 加哇达给刚哇木

en: Saluting them with an endless ocean of praise,
An ocean of sounds of different melodies,
I sing of the buddhas’ noble qualities
And praise all those who have gone to perfect bliss.

tr: dé dak ngakpa mizé gyamtso nam
yang kyi yenlak gyamtso dra kün gyi
gyelwa kün gyi yönten rap jö ching
dewar shekpa tamché dak gi tö
tr_zh: 喋达 阿巴米色佳措南
央吉炎拉佳措 札贡寄
加哇贡寄远殿 拉觉净
喋哇谢巴趟界达给对

en: To every buddha, I make offerings:
Of the loveliest flowers, of beautiful garlands,
Of music and perfumed ointments, the best of parasols,
The brightest lamps, and finest incense.

tr: silnyen nam dang jukpa duk chok dang
marmé chok dang dukpö dampa yi
gyelwa dé dak la ni chöpar gyi
tr_zh: 美豆当巴秤哇当巴档
似念南档 祝贝 独秋档
玛美秋档独布当巴宜
加哇喋达拉尼却巴寄

en: To every buddha, I make offerings:
Exquisite garments and the most fragrant scents,
Powdered incense, heaped as high as Mount Meru,
And all arranged in perfect symmetry.

tr: naza dampa nam dang dri chok dang
köpa khyépar pakpé chok kün gyi
gyelwa dé dak la ni chöpar gyi
tr_zh: 拿洒当巴 南档 执秋档
切美铺玛利拉酿巴档
贵巴切巴帕贝 秋贡寄
加哇喋达拉扬却巴寄

en: Then the vast and unsurpassable offering—
Inspired by my devotion to all the buddhas, and
Moved by the power of my faith in Good Actions—
I prostrate in offering to all you victorious ones.

tr: dé dak gyelwa tamché la yang mö
zangpo chö la dépé top dak gi
gyelwa kün la chaktsel chöpar gyi
tr_zh: 却巴刚南喇美佳切哇
喋达加哇趟界拉扬木
桑波倔贝多达给
加哇贡拉洽擦却巴寄

en: Whatever negative acts I have committed,
While driven by desire, anger, and ignorance,
With my body, my speech, and my mind,
Before you, I confess and purify each and every one.

tr: döchak zhédang timuk wang gi ni
lü dang ngak dang dézhin yi kyi kyang
dikpa dak gi gyipa chi chipa
dé dak tamché dak gi sosor shak
tr_zh: 多治协档帝木旺给尼
吕档 雅档 喋行 宜吉江
迪巴达给机巴季契巴
喋达趟界达给梭梭夏

en: With a heart full of delight, I rejoice at all the merits
Of buddhas and bodhisattvas,
Pratyeka-buddhas, those in training, and arhats beyond training,
And every living being, throughout the entire universe.

tr: chok chü gyelwa kün dang sangyé sé
rangyel nam dang lop dang mi lop dang
drowa kün gyi sönam gang la yang
dé dak kün gyi jésu dak yirang
tr_zh: 秋具加哇贡档 桑杰色
嚷加 南档 洛档 米洛档
卓哇 贡寄苏南 刚拉扬
喋达贡寄杰速达宜嚷

en: You who are like beacons of light shining through the worlds,
Who passed through the stages of enlightenment to attain buddhahood, from all attachment free at last—
Protectors, I exhort you all:
Turn the unsurpassable wheel of Dharma!

tr: gang nam chok chü jikten drönma nam
jangchup rimpar sangyé ma chak nyé
gönpo dé dak dak gi tamché la
tr_zh: 刚南秋具 吉殿 尊玛达
蒋秋仁巴桑杰玛洽涅
贡波 喋达达给汤界拉
阔罗 喇拿美巴国哇固

en: Joining my palms together,
I pray to you who intend to pass into nirvana,
Please remain, for as many aeons as there are atoms in this world,
And bring well-being and happiness to us all!

tr: nyangen datön gang zhé dé dak la
drowa kün la pen zhing dewé chir
kelpa zhing gi dül nyé zhukpar yang
dak gi telmo rap jar sölwar gyi
tr_zh: 拿恩达顿刚协喋达拉
卓哇贡拉遍行喋威契
嘎巴行给独涅淑巴扬
达给踏摩拉夹索哇寄

en: What little virtue I have gathered through my homage,
Offering, confession, and rejoicing,
Through my exhortation, and prayer—
I dedicate it all to the enlightenment of beings!

tr: chaktselwa dang chö ching shakpa dang
jésu yirang kül zhing sölwa yi
gewa chung zé dak gi chi sakpa
tamché dak gi jangchup chir ngo
tr_zh: 洽擦哇档却净夏巴档
杰速宜嚷固行梭哇宜
给哇炯谁达给季萨巴
唐界达寄蒋秋 契喔哦

en: Om ah hung. On behalf of all beings, I offer༔
All our bodies, possessions, and sources of merit,༔
The four continents, Mount Meru, the sun and the moon,༔
All the unimaginable delights of gods and humans.༔

tr: om ah hung༔ dak dang tayé semchen gyi༔
tr_zh: 嗡 阿 吽 達倘 他耶 森間吉
吕档 隆觉 给措棍
令息仁拉尼达界
拉米隆觉桑米洽

rubric.en: And thus:

en: Continuously manifesting all of these༔
As Samantabhadra offering-clouds༔
To the deities of the Three Jewels and the Three Roots,༔
And to the ocean of Dharma protectors and wealth deities—༔
Continuously I offer them, with devotion.༔
May our great accumulation of merit be perfected༔
And the light of wisdom illuminate the world!༔

tr: gyün mi chepar trül jé té༔
tr_zh: 棍桑却贝进崩切
局米切巴竹切喋
棍秋仁浅杂哇速
却松诺拉佳措拉
固贝达都布哇吉
苏南措浅拉作涅
耶谢囊哇杰巴修

tr: om guru deva dakini sarva ratna mandala pudza megha ah hung༔
tr_zh: 嗡咕如喋哇達給尼薩哇熱那曼達拉布雜美 嘎 阿吽

en: Namo. Buddha, Dharma and Sangha,༔
Guru, yidam and dakini,༔
Dharma guardians, wealth gods and Treasure lords—༔
From an identical wisdom-essence༔

tr: namo, sangyé chö dang gendün dang༔
tr_zh: 南摩桑杰却倘 给敦倘
喇嘛 宜唐康卓倘
却宋 诺拉 喋吉达
耶谢 吉格 峨喔列

rubric.en: With this, offer the mandala.

en: The unobscured nature can appear as anything at all,༔
With the capacity for wondrous enlightened activity.༔
To you, our refuge and the protectors of all beings,༔
To all of you, sovereigns of wisdom and compassion,༔

tr: dro kün kyap dang gön gyurpa༔
tr_zh: 让欣 玛嘎 吉扬敦
突杰 庆列 美波切
卓棍 佳倘 棍秋巴
浅则 达尼 切南拉

en: I pay homage and take heartfelt refuge in you.༔
I present my body and wealth as offerings.༔
With your compassion please always protect me༔
And the many countless other sentient beings.༔

tr: chaktsal nying né kyap su chi༔
tr_zh: 洽擦 宁涅 佳速契
吕倘 隆觉 却巴布
达倘 他耶 森间南
大都 突杰 佳则梭

en: Pacify illness and evil influences;༔
Increase our lifespan and merits;༔
Grant your blessings that everything we wish for༔
Be accomplished in harmony with the Dharma!༔

tr_zh: 涅倘 虐巴 息哇倘
查倘 虽南 佩哇倘
桑贝 屯南 玛吕棍
却欣 竹巴 钦吉洛

rubric_after.en:
With that, the desired aims are requested.
Next, present the specific offering three times to the Noble Lady and recite the praises

en: Perfected in an instant of recollection,༔
I am vividly present in the form of the Noble Lady.༔
Upon the moon in my heart center,༔
Boundless rays of light stream forth from the green tam,༔

tr_zh: 让尼给吉真作速
杰尊帕玛固萨威
突嘎 达丁当江固
喋列 伟瑟 巴耶吹

en: Inviting the Noble Lady’s twenty-one emanations༔
And an ocean of Precious Ones, swirling and billowing,༔
Inviting them to appear in the sky before me.༔

tr_zh: 巴玛 南出 涅吉倘
棍秋 佳翠 进戳哇
敦吉 南卡 间昌秋

en: Tam. From the non-arising space of luminous dharmakaya,༔
In the unobstructed wisdom form of the Noble Lady༔
Manifest as the Magical Net to touch any who are in need,༔
Please approach, arya Tare Jah!༔
zh: 當 無生明光法身界

tr_zh: 当 皆美伟萨却固映
嘎美帕美耶谢固
康读 究出 札哇夏
促谢阿雅大列杂

en: Because of your love for me and all sentient beings,༔
And because you possess such miraculous powers,༔
For as long as I may honor you,༔
Blessed One, please remain seated!༔

tr: dak dang dro la tuk tsé chir༔
nyi kyi dzutrül tu yi ni༔
tr_zh: 达倘卓拉突则契
尼吉 卒出 突宜尼
其夕 却巴 达吉巴
喋夕 炯殿 修速梭
貝瑪 嘎瑪 拉呀 當

en: Om. Actually present and mentally created,༔
These offering clouds of Samantabhadra,༔
Lavishly filling the expanse of dharmadhatu—༔
I offer to Noble Tara and her retinue!༔
zh: 嗡 實設意幻所出生

tr: om, ngöjor yi lé jungwa yi༔
tr_zh: 嗡 约觉 宜列 冲哇宜
棍都 桑波 御进吉
御映杰巴冈切喋
巴玛卓玛扩皆御

tr: om arya taré sapariwara benza argham pratitsa soha
om arya taré sapariwara benza padam pratitsa soha
om arya taré sapariwara benza pushpé pratitsa soha
om arya taré sapariwara benza düpé pratitsa soha
om arya taré sapariwara benza aloké pratitsa soha
om arya taré sapariwara benza gendhé pratitsa soha
om arya taré sapariwara benza naividyé pratitsa soha
om arya taré sapariwara benza shapda pratitsa soha
tr_zh: 嗡 阿呀大列 薩巴仁 哇拉 班雜 阿貢 札地查 梭哈
嗡 阿呀大列 薩巴仁 哇拉 班雜 巴當 札地查 梭哈
嗡 阿呀大列 薩巴仁 哇拉 班雜 布貝 札地查 梭哈
嗡 阿呀大列 薩巴仁 哇拉 班雜 都貝 札地查 梭哈
嗡 阿呀大列 薩巴仁 哇拉 班雜 阿洛給 札地查 梭哈
嗡 阿呀大列 薩巴仁 哇拉 班雜 根諜 札地查 梭哈
嗡 阿呀大列 薩巴仁 哇拉 班雜 涅威諜 札地查 梭哈
嗡 阿呀大列 薩巴仁 哇拉 班雜 夏達 札地查 梭哈

en: Om ah Hung.༔ The three realms, environment and inhabitants, all richness and splendor,༔
My body, possessions, and each and every virtue,༔
I offer to the lords of compassion.༔
Accept them all and bestow your blessings, I pray!༔

tr: om ah hung, kham sum nöchü paljor dang
dak lü longchö gé tsok kün
zhé né jingyi lap tu sol
tr_zh: 嗡 阿 吽 康宋虐居巴觉倘
达吕 隆觉 给措棍
突杰 达尼 南拉布
谐涅 杰吉 拉都梭

rubric.en: With this, invite the deities and make offerings.

tr: om sarva tathagata ratna mandala pudza ho
tr_zh: 嗡 薩哇 大他嘎大 熱那 曼達拉 布雜 吽

rubric_after.en: With that, make the specific mandala offering and recite the King of Praises

en: Om. Homage to the noble lady Tara!
zh: 嗡 頂禮至尊聖度母

tr: om, jétsünma pakma drolma la chaktsel lo
tr_zh: 嗡 杰尊玛帕玛 卓玛拉洽擦罗

en: Homage to Tara, swift and gallant;
Homage to Tuttara, banishing fear;
Homage to Turé, all needs fulfilling;
With svaha we offer you honor and praise!

tr_zh: 洽擦 大咧 纽玛 巴摩
都大 咧宜 吉巴 瑟玛
都咧 屯棍 谨贝 卓玛
梭哈 宜给 却拉 读多

en: Homage to Tara, swift and gallant,
With glance that flashes like flares of lightning;
Born on the heart of a blossoming lotus
That rose from the tears of the Triple-World’s Lord.

tr: chen ni kéchik lok dang drama
tr_zh: 洽擦 卓玛 纽玛 巴摩
见尼 给吉 洛倘 札玛
吉滨 速棍 秋皆 暇吉
给萨 切哇 咧尼 琼玛

en: Homage to you, your countenance glowing
Like a hundred full moons gathered in autumn,
Lustrous and smiling with brilliant radiance,
Like a thousand stars clustered, ablaze.

tr_zh: 洽擦 敦给 达哇 贡都
康哇 佳尼 则贝 暇玛
嘎玛 东诧 措巴 南吉
拉都 切威 伟拉 巴玛

title.en: 2. Tārā White as the Autumn Moon

en: Homage, golden lady, your lotus-hand
Is graced with a water flower, blue in color;
You are generosity, perseverance, diligence,
Serenity, patience and meditation.
zh: 佈施 精進 息苦行

tr_zh: 洽擦 瑟喔 秋涅 皆吉
贝美 洽尼 南巴 间玛
谨巴 尊竹 嘎突 息哇
虽巴 桑滇 觉优 尼玛

en: Homage to you, whose victories are endless,
The jewel on the great Tathagata’s crown;
You are well served by the heirs of the Victors,
Those who’ve accomplished all the perfections.

tr_zh: 洽擦 喋欣 谢贝 卒多
他耶 南巴 佳哇 觉玛
玛吕 帕若 钦巴 托贝
佳威 瑟吉 欣都 滇玛

en: Homage to you, who with tuttara and hung
Fill the realms of desire to the ends of space;
You trample underfoot the seven worlds,
summoning all at your strong command. your.

tr: dö dang chok dang namkha gangma
tr_zh: 洽擦 都大 拉吽 宜给
堆倘 秋倘 南卡 刚玛
吉滨 敦波 暇吉 念喋
吕巴 美巴 固巴 奴玛

title.en: 5. Tārā Proclaiming the Sound of Hūṃ

en: Homage to you, praised by Indra,
By Agni, Brahma, Maruts, and Shiva;
All the hosts of bhutas, vetalas,
Gandharvas and yakshas pay tribute to you.
zh: 自在 風 火神供養
部多 起屍 尋香等

tr: nöjin tsok kyi dün né töma
tr_zh: 洽擦 佳钦 美拉 仓巴
隆拉 那措 旺秋 却玛
炯波 若朗 知撒 南倘
唐谨 措吉 敦涅 堆玛

title.en: 6. Tārā Victorious over the Three Worlds

en: Homage to you, who with tré and pé
Crush the enemies’ yantras to dust;
With right leg bent in and left leg extended,
Shining, you stamp amid flames wildly blazing.

tr: chaktsel trat chéja dang pat kyi
tr_zh: 洽擦 遮界 洽倘 呸吉
帕若 出扩 拉都 炯玛
耶固 元江 暇吉 念喋
美巴 出巴 欣都 巴玛

en: Homage to Ture, lady most fearsome,
You who destroy the most powerful demons;
With lotus-face and a deep-furrowed brow,
You’re the slayer of each and every foe.

tr_zh: 洽擦 都咧 吉巴 千谟
读吉 巴喔 南巴 炯玛
秋界 暇涅 戮涅 滇则
札喔 汤界 玛吕 虽玛

en: Homage to you, your fingers gracing
Your heart and displaying the Three Jewels mudra;
Graced with wheels adorning every direction,
Your dazzling radiance overwhelms all.

tr_zh: 洽擦 贡秋 速村 洽界
梭谟 突嘎 南巴 间玛
玛吕 秋吉 扩洛 间贝
让格 峨吉 措南 出玛

en: Homage to you, supremely joyous,
Your splendorous crown spreading garlands of light;
Smiling and laughing, your cry of tuttaré
Means demons and worlds all fall into line.

tr: dü dang jikten wang du dzéma
tr_zh: 洽擦 拉都 嘎威 吉贝
邬间 峨吉 趁威 悲玛
谐巴 拉谐 都大 拉宜
读倘 吉滨 旺突 则玛

en: Homage lady, you who can summon
All the hosts of earthly guardians;
With your quivering frown and the syllable Hung
You deliver us all from every misfortune.

tr_zh: 洽擦 萨息 炯威 措南
汤界 固巴 奴巴 尼玛
戳涅 唷威 宜给 吽格
朋巴 汤界 南巴 卓玛

en: Homage to you, so brightly adorned,
With a sliver of moon as the crest on your crown;
Your locks are graced by Amitabha,
Whose gleaming rays stream endlessly on.

tr_zh: 洽擦 达威 突模 邬间
间巴 汤界 欣都 巴玛
哇贝 吹拿 峨巴 美列
大巴 欣都 峨尼 则玛

en: Homage to you, in a halo seated,
Blazing with flames, apocalyptic;

Serenity, patience and meditation.

The jewel on the great Tathagata’s crown;
You are well served by the heirs of the Victors,
Those who’ve accomplished all the perfections.

Fill the realms of desire to the ends of space;
You trample underfoot the seven worlds,
summoning all at your strong command. your.

By Agni, Brahma, Maruts, and Shiva;
All the hosts of bhutas, vetalas,
Gandharvas and yakshas pay tribute to you.

en: Homage to you, who with tré and pé
Crush the enemies’ yantras to dust;
With right leg bent in and left leg extended,
Shining, you stamp amid flames wildly blazing.

en: Homage to Ture, lady most fearsome,
You who destroy the most powerful demons;
With lotus-face and a deep-furrowed brow,
You’re the slayer of each and every foe.

秋界 暇涅 戮涅 滇则
札喔 汤界 玛吕 虽玛

en: Homage to you, your fingers gracing
Your heart and displaying the Three Jewels mudra;
Graced with wheels adorning every direction,
Your dazzling radiance overwhelms all.

Your splendorous crown spreading garlands of light;
Smiling and laughing, your cry of tuttaré
Means demons and worlds all fall into line.

读倘 吉滨 旺突 则玛

en: Homage lady, you who can summon
All the hosts of earthly guardians;
With your quivering frown and the syllable Hung
You deliver us all from every misfortune.

戳涅 唷威 宜给 吽格
朋巴 汤界 南巴 卓玛

en: Homage to you, so brightly adorned,
With a sliver of moon as the crest on your crown;
Your locks are graced by Amitabha,
Whose gleaming rays stream endlessly on.

tr_zh: 洽擦 达威 突朴 邬间
间巴 汤界 欣都 巴玛
哇贝 吹拿 峨巴 美咧
大巴 欣都 峨惹 则玛

en: Homage to you, in a halo seated,
Blazing with flames, apocalyptic;
Your right leg stretched out and left bent inward,
Immersed in joy, you crush legions of foes.

tr: yé kyang yön kum kün nékor gé
tr_zh: 洽擦 嘎贝 他美 美大
巴威 趁威 吾那 涅玛
耶江 元固 棍涅 郭嘎
札宜 绷尼 南巴 炯玛

en: Homage to you, as on the earth’s surface
You strike your palms and stamp your feet;
Your brow deeply furrowed, with Hung you smash
The netherworlds seven and grind them to dust.

tr: til gyi nün ching zhap kyi dungma

戳涅 浅则 宜给 吽格
仁巴 敦波 南尼 给玛

en: Homage to you, blissful, gracious and tranquil,
You whose domain is the peace of nirvana;
With om and soha in perfect union,
You lay to waste every terrible evil.

tr: soha om dang yang dak denpé

en: Homage to you, immersed in rapture;
You shatter the bodies of all your foes;
you appear from the wisdom-syllable hung,
And display, in full, your ten-syllable mantra.

tr_zh: 洽擦 棍涅 郭拉 嘎威

瑞巴 吽咧 卓玛 尼玛

en: Homage to Turé, your feet stomping boldly,
Formed from the seed of the syllable Hung;
The mountains of Meru, Mandara and Vindhya,
And all the three worlds, they quake and tremble.

tr_zh: 洽擦 都咧 暇尼 达贝

瑞拉 面达 拉倘 比切
吉滨 速南 唷哇 尼玛

en: Homage to you, who hold in your hand
A deer-marked moon, a lake divine;
With tara twice and then with pé,
You totally cleanse all toxins and poisons.

tr_zh: 洽擦 拉宜 措宜 南贝

读南 玛吕 巴尼 瑟玛

en: Homage to you, whom kings love to serve–
Kings of hosts of gods and kimnaras;
Clad in your armor of joy and splendor,
You clear away nightmares, soothe away strife.

tr_zh: 洽擦 拉宜 措南 佳波

贡涅 果洽 嘎威 吉吉
最倘 米浪 恩巴 瑟玛

en: Homage to you, eyes shining and lustrous,
Bright with the fullness of sun and moon;
With twice-uttered hara and then with tuttaré
You pacify even the cruelest diseases.

欣都 察波 仁涅 瑟玛

en: Homage to you with the power to liberate,
You who demonstrate threefold reality;
Turé supreme, you completely destroy
The hordes of grahas, vetalas, and yakshas.

Just by bringing it to mind, they are granted total courage.
It pacifies every misdeed,
Overcomes all roads to the lower realms,

From seven million conquerers.
In this life, one achieves superior qualities;
And ultimately, one arrives at the state of the buddhas.

Locally found or transported from elsewhere,
Whether ingested or imbibed,
Will be completely expelled.

en: Harm from evil, affliction from plague or venom—
All such miseries are eliminated
For other sentient beings too.

Those wanting children will have them,
Those wanting wealth will be prosperous,
One’s every wish will be fulfilled,
Obstacles will vanish, and every problem will be overcome.

en: Om. You appeared from the face of Lokeshvara,
In the lotus family of Amitabha.
Queen of activity of all the buddhas,
Noble Tara, I offer you honor and praise.

tr_zh: 嗡 囊哇 他耶 贝美仁
吉殿 旺秋 夏列冲
桑杰 棍吉 庆列达
帕玛 卓玛 洽擦多

rubric.en: Thus make offerings with this mantra.

en: To all those worthy of praise,
With bodies as numerous as all the dust motes in the world,
With deep respect and fervent devotion,
Always I will offer you honor and praise.

秋都 喋贝 洽擦多

en: Sublime and noble Lady, with your retinue,
Lovingly regard me with compassion, beyond the bounds of thought!
Bless me so that no obstacles block
The fulfillment of all my prayers!

tr_zh: 杰尊 帕玛 扩倘界

达吉 其大 梭威屯
给美 竹巴 钦吉洛

en: May the Buddha’s teachings spread and flourish!
May the holders of the teachings live in harmony and good health!
May obstacles that threaten them subside!
May their activities of teaching and practice prosper!

tr_zh: 桑杰 殿巴 达兴杰
殿进 突吞 夏贝殿
涅查 巴切 棍息兴
谢竹 庆列 佩哇作

en: May all sickness and famine, fighting and strife, recede!
May spiritual richness increase yet further!
May the spiritual rulers’ kingdoms expand!
May every country near and far be in harmony!

tr_zh: 涅木 出最 息哇倘

佳堪 他鸟 喋哇作

en: Protect us from untimely death and the sixteen threats,
From menacing dreams and sinister omens,
From the miseries of samsara’s lower realms,
From every peril, now and always!

en: Increase our life, merit, capacity, experience and realization!
May harmful notions not intrude!
May the twofold awakened mind arise, free of effort!
May our aims be fulfilled in accordance with the Dharma!

en: From now until supreme enlightenment,
Like a mother protects her only child,
Safeguard us always with your kindness!
Let us be indivisible from you!

Blessed to be indivisible from her,
I turn into the form of Noble Tara,
Visible yet insubstantial.

en: For anything lacking or incomplete,
Or beyond my ability to perform—
Whatever mistakes I have committed,
Please bear witness and forgive them all!

en: Here, together with this physical support,
Please remain for as long as samsara endures,
And grant us health, long life, prosperity,
And all supreme accomplishments!

I settle within the original state of dharmadhatu.

Accomplish the state of Noble Tara.
And may I bring each and every being,
Without a single exception, to that very same state.

en: Like the wish-fulfilling jewel and the vase of bounty,
Unimpeded, every wish you fulfill.
Noble Tara, conquerors and your heirs,
Bestow the auspiciousness that we may be forever nurtured by your compassion.

May we beings, all of us, infinite in number,
May we purify the two obscurations, swiftly perfect the two accumulations,
And so attain the state of perfect awakening!

May we find supreme happiness among gods and humans!
May all obstacles to the attainment of omniscience,
All harmful forces, all sickness and disease,

tr_zh: 喋玛 托吉 查拉 棍度样
拉倘 米依 喋威 秋托涅
汤切 千巴 竹巴 杰巴拉
巴切 顿给 仁倘 涅拉梭

en: All that brings untimely death,
All bad dreams and evil omens,
The eight dangers and all harm—
May all be swiftly pacified and purged!

tr: milam ngen dang tsenma ngenpa dang
jikpa gyé sok nyewar tsewa nam
nyurdu zhi zhing mepar dzedu söl
tr_zh: 度明 起哇 秋巴 拿措档
米浪 恩倘 粲玛 恩巴档
吉巴 界梭 涅哇 则哇南
纽突 息兴 美巴 则突梭

en: May auspiciousness, happiness, and prosperity,
Both worldly and transcendent,
Flourish and expand, and may all our wishes
Be effortlessly and spontaneously fulfilled!

tr: pel zhing gyepé dön nam malüpa
bemé lhün gyi drüpar dzedu söl
tr_zh: 吉殿 吉殿 列尼 喋巴宜
札希 喋列 喷宋 措巴南
佩兴 杰贝 顿南 玛吕巴
贝美 轮吉 竹巴 则突梭

en: May we endeavor in the practice, may the Dharma spread,
May we always meditate on you, and behold your perfect face;
May we realize the nature of emptiness, and may precious bodhicitta
Develop and expand, just like the waxing moon!

tr: drup la tsön zhing damchö pelwa dang
tak tu khyé drup zhel chok tongwa dang
yar ngö datar pel zhing gyepar dzö
tr_zh: 竹拉 尊兴 唐却 佩哇档
大度 却竹 夏秋 通哇档
东尼 屯多 姜森 仁波切
雅哦 达大 佩兴 杰巴作

en: May I be reborn in a beautiful lotus flower,
In that excellent and joyous buddha-realm,
And may the Buddha Amitabha himself
Grant me the prophecy foretelling my enlightenment!

tr: gyelwé kyilkhor zang zhing gawa der
pemo dampa shintu dzé lé kyé
lungtenpa yang dak gi der top shok
tr_zh: 佳威 吉扩 桑兴 嘎哇喋
贝摩 档巴 信都 则列界
囊哇 他耶 佳威 恩宋突
龙殿 巴样 达吉 喋托秀

en: Divine goddess whom I’ve accomplished in previous lives,
Noble Lady, who performs the activity of the buddhas of all three times,
Swift heroine, blue-green, with one face and two hands,
Mother who holds an utpala flower—may all be auspicious!

tr: dusüm sangyé kün gyi trinlé ma
ngo jang zhel chik chak nyi nyur zhi pa
yum gyur utpel nampé trashi shok
tr_zh: 达格 查拉 根度 竹贝拉
度宋 桑杰 根吉 庆列玛
哦姜 夏吉 洽尼 纽兴巴
雍久 乌巴 南贝 札西秀

en: Victorious mother Tara—with your noble form,
Your entourage, your lifespan and pure-land,
And your fine and excellent marks—
May I and all others become just like you!

tr: gyel yum drölma khyé ku chindra dang
khor dang kutsé tsé dang zhing kham dang
khyé kyi tsen chok zangpo chidrawa
dendra khonar dak sok gyurwar shok
tr_zh: 佳容 卓玛 切固 吉札档
扣档 古查 查档 兴堪档
切吉 粲秋 桑波 知札哇
喋札 扣拿 达拿 久哇秀

en: Through the power of our praise and supplication,
Bestow upon each one of us, no matter where we be,
Freedom from illness, from harm, destitution, and conflict,
And make the Dharma and auspiciousness increase!
zh: 達梭 康度 涅貝 薩秋速 吾等無論居於何方所
涅檔 烏朋 達最 西哇檔 貧窮疾病逆緣悉平息
卻檔 札西 佩哇 則突梭 佛法吉祥祈令俱增勝

tr: khyé la tö ching sölwa tapé tü
dak sok gang na nepé sa chok su
né dön ül pong tap tsö zhiwa dang
chö dang trashi pelwar dzedu söl
tr_zh: 切拉 多清 梭哇 达贝突
達梭 康度 涅貝 薩秋速 吾等無論居於何方所
涅檔 烏朋 達最 西哇檔 貧窮疾病逆緣悉平息
卻檔 札西 佩哇 則突梭 佛法吉祥祈令俱增勝

title.en: The Tambura of Devotion: A Supplication Invoking the Crucial Essence of the Vows of the Noble Lady Wish-Fulfilling Wheel
title.zh: 圣母如意轮心要祈请文虔诚之琴弦

en: From the vast lake of Avalokiteśvara’s compassion,
Awater lily of benefit and happiness bloomed gloriously:
Noble Tārā, shining with the light of nectar—
Dispel the terrifying forces of darkness!

tr: jik ché münpé lab di zhiwar dzö
tr_zh: 坚热森旺宁吉曲德勒
偏德格德杰贝巴桌巴
帕玛卓玛德则奥囊坚
吉杰木冰拉迪西瓦则

en: Mother of all buddhas, balm that heals my pain,
Loving nurse, only friend to all beings,
In all my lifetimes, you have been my most sublime protector.
Until the heart of awakening, I rely on you for refuge!

tr: gyal kün yum gyur dungwa selwé men
kyab khyö nyingpö bardu kyab su ten
tr_zh: 杰棍云居东瓦色韦勉
江贝玛玛杰古年吉布
策热陈瓦浦德玛奇冰
杰趣宁布巴德杰苏登

en: Beings like me, tormented by karma,
Wherever we are born, are constantly plagued
By illness, war, famine, and so on.
Drag me from this swamp of suffering, O Noble Lady!

tr: dak sok lé kyi narwé drowa nam
gangdu né kyang né tsön mugé sok
mindö dumé yangyang tsé lak na
dukngal dam né drong shik jetsünma
tr_zh: 德索列吉纳韦卓瓦南
冈德内江内尊穆吉索
米多杜梅央央泽拉纳
杜阿当内仲效杰尊玛

en: Like ripples on water, my thoughts follow habitual patterns,
And every single moment I create
Many causes for lower rebirths.
Eradicate these endless seeds of saṃsāra right away, O Noble Lady!

tr: bakchak jé drang namtok chu nyer tar
kechik rerer ngendrö gyu mang sak
khorwé sabön dzé du mé pa di
zhi tsa danta chö chik jetsünma
tr_zh: 巴恰杰让南托曲涅达
嘎吉热热恩卓居芒巴
科韦萨本宰杜美巴迪
西匝达达切效杰尊玛

en: Since thus far I have failed to gather the great accumulations,
Although I pride myself on having faithfully entered the Buddhadharma,
I am unable to entrust myself to the Three Jewels.
Rip out these karmic obscurations from their root, O Noble Lady!

tr: depé gyalwé ten gor zhuk lom kyang
könchok sum la lo té makhelwé
tr_zh: 德居措陈昂杜玛颂韦
德贝杰韦丹戈雄隆江
棍切松拉洛德玛吉贝
列哲匝内雄效杰尊玛

en: Even if I see it ripen right before my eyes,
I still don’t believe in the karmic law of cause and effect.
I’m just a wild beast clad in saffron robes.
Lead my mindto virtue, O Noble Lady!

tr: ngönsum du yang minpar gyur tong na
dadung lé dang lé kyi drebu la
dak yi gé la drong shik jetsünma
tr_zh: 昂松杜央敏巴居通纳
达东列当列杰德布拉
伊切玛杰坚赞俄热多
德伊格拉仲效杰尊玛

en: Day and night, moment by moment, my body decays.
Until I have fulfilled the great purpose of this excellent human life,
Cut the lasso of the Lord of Death, so difficult to escape,
With your sword of wisdom, O Noble Lady!

tr: nyintsen kechik mi tak mi yi lü
tr_zh: 宁灿嘎吉米达米伊律
扬达杰拉敦陈玛珠瓦
多巴嘎瓦器达夏贝居
耶谢热吉切效杰尊玛

en: In every situation, quickly protect me from the eight or sixteen dangers—
Evil forces, epidemics, poison, weapons,
Sudden death at the hands of wicked people,
Fires, floods, or wild animals, O Noble Lady!

tr: nekab su yang dön dang rim duk tsön
lobur nyi du shi ngen chiwa dang
mé chu chen sok gyé dang chudruk gi
jik lé nyur tu kyob shik jetsünma
tr_zh: 内嘎苏央敦当仁杜尊
洛布涅杜希恩器瓦当
美曲坚索杰当居杜吉
吉列纽杜久效杰尊玛

en: As long as self-clinging and bad habits are present in my mindstream,
The river of suffering will continue to flow.
Thus, I should know the nature of the skandhas and so on.
Light the lamp of that understanding for me, O Noble Lady!

tr: dakdzin ngen gom sem kyi gyün jisi
pung sok rangzhin yongsu shepa yi
tr_zh: 德津恩贡森吉居吉岁
德岁杜额曲沃达博巴
普索朗欣永苏谢巴伊
托贝敦美波效杰尊玛

en: Recognition of beings as my mothers, love, and compassion
Are qualities I should not just talk about;
Heroic bodhisattvas exchange their happiness for others’ suffering.
Help me to muster such vast courage, O Noble Lady!

tr: dro nam mar shé jam dang nying tsewa
tsik tsam minpar zhen gyi dukngal dang
dak dé ngö su jewé pa nam kyi
nyingtob lab chen kyé chik jetsünma
tr_zh: 卓南玛谢江当宁贼瓦
次仓明巴贤吉杜额当
德德欧苏杰韦巴南吉
宁多拉杰吉金杰尊玛

en: In all my future lives, may I meet an authentic teacher
And fully understand all teachings they impart.
Destroy Māra’s army of obstacles to life and liberation
Until I reach awakening, O Noble Lady!

tr: geweshé jal dé tenchö kün tok
changchub bardu tsé dang tar sok la
tr_zh: 策热坤图辛吉玛洛贝
格韦谢杰德丹曲坤托
江趣瓦杜策当塔索拉
瓦觉德邦雄效杰尊玛

en: Grant me the profound wisdom to see with pure eyes,
A good character with little inclination to afflictive mental states,
Which fosters deep devotion to spiritual training with mindfulness and alertness.
Mergemy mind with the Dharma, O Noble Lady!

tr: lo mik duldral zabmö sherab den
nyönmong bak kyi chungwé zo zangwé
lab la rab gü dren dang shezhin par
dak gyü chö dang sé shik jetsünma
tr_zh: 洛米德哲萨莫谢拉丹
纽孟巴吉琼韦佐桑韦
拉拉热古赞当谢欣巴
德居曲当赛效杰尊玛

en: When the karma that keeps me in this life is spent,
Ease the agonies of death and help me realize the eleven thoughts;
Show me my true nature, luminosity, with decisive recognition of the dhātu,
Free from the extremes of origination and cessation, O Noble Lady!

tr: namzhik tsé yi penpa dzokpé tsé
né chö mepar dushé chu tok né
tr_zh: 南雄策伊片巴卓贝策
内觉美巴杜谢居托内
杰噶塔德英苏拉达韦
奥萨朗额约效杰尊玛

en: Even if the bardo arises for just a fleeting instant,
Let my pure perception of the emanation and dissolution of the maṇḍala be complete.
Take me to Abhirati, the lotus-arrayed realm of Sukhāvatī,
Or any other buddha field—O Noble Lady!

tr: bardo kechik yütsam shar na yang
dakpé zhing du kyol zhik jetsünma
tr_zh: 瓦多嘎吉尤赞萨纳扬
达囊吉阔阔洛卓杜卓
昂嘎威丹贝莫古拉索
达贝辛杜焦效杰尊玛

en: Unless I consciously decide to be born in saṃsāra,
Don’t let me circle helplessly here due to my karma.
Guide me to Buddha Boundless Life and Light
To receive his prophecy, O Noble Lady!

tr: wangmé lé kyi khorwar mi khorwar
tsé ö tayé gyalwé zhab drung du
lung tön lam na drong shik jetsünma
tr_zh: 桑欣斯帕瑞巴玛托巴
旺美列吉科瓦米科瓦
策奥塔耶杰韦夏仲杜
隆敦兰纳仲效杰尊玛

en: In the vast ocean of realms, whether there are buddhas or not,
May I guard the sublime Dharma with my life
And fully teach the excellent conduct of the bodhisattvas.
Please fulfill this wish of mine, O Noble Lady!

tr: sangye jön dang majön zhing gyatso
tayé küntu damchö sok tar zung
changchub chö chok dzokpar tön gyipé
tr_zh: 桑杰炯当玛炯辛加措
塔耶坤杜丹曲索达松
江趣约乔佐巴敦杰贝
门兰珠巴则效杰尊玛

en: While in this body, may all the misdeeds, karmic obscurations, and transgressions
I have accumulated since time immemorial be purified,
And until then, let me be in harmony with the Dharma,
And grant the siddhi of immortality, O Noble Lady!

tr: tokmé né sak dikdrib nyetung kün
lü ten di la jang zhing dakpa dang
desi chö tün pal dang chimé kyi
tr_zh: 托内萨迪哲涅通坤
吕登迪拉江欣达巴当
德岁曲屯贝当器美吉
策旺欧珠索效杰尊玛

en: Even in my dreams, may bodhicitta never wane,
And may I fully turn away from Māra’s machinations.
Let all my actions of body, speech, and mind be a powerful source
Of benefit and prosperity for the teachings and beings, O Noble Lady!

tr: milam du yang changchub chok gi sem
mi nyam dü kyi lé kün yong pang té
go sum jawa chigyi ten dro yi
pendé zung su pel zhik jetsünma
tr_zh: 美兰杜扬江趣约吉森
米年德吉列坤永邦代
戈松加瓦吉杰丹卓伊
偏德尊苏佩效杰尊玛

en: Let me leave behind the eight worldly dharmas and distractions of this life,
So that in the solitude of the woods, unbothered by obstacles,
I may concentrate on meditation practice alone.
In this way, make this human life meaningful, O Noble Lady!

tr: chö gyé tsé di nam yeng rab pang né
bé té nak su barchö machipar
drub la nyingpor drilwé tsé diru
tr_zh: 曲杰策伊南英热邦内
贝泰纳苏瓦觉玛赤巴
珠拉宁波哲韦策迪热
米吕敦丹则效杰尊玛

en: Let this duḥkha I’m experiencing right now
Quickly exhaust the causes and effects
Of all living beings’ sufferings,
And guide us from happiness to happiness, O Noble Lady!

tr: dak gi dantar nyongwé duh kha di
drowa kün gyi dukngal gyu dang dré
nyur tu zé né chinché dakzhen kün
dé né dewar tri chik jetsünma
tr_zh: 达吉达达纽韦杜哈迪
卓瓦坤吉杜额居当德
纽杜萨内辛恰德贤坤
德内德瓦基效杰尊玛

en: Let the supreme Buddhadharma, source of benefit and happiness,
Spread and flourish in all ten directions without ever waning,
And please prolong the lives of all the great masters
Who upholdit, O Noble Lady!

tr: nubmé chok chu küntu dar zhing gyé
dé dzin kyé chen dampa malüpé
kutsé ring du sing shik jetsünma
tr_zh: 偏德琼内杰韦丹巴乔
努美效居坤图达欣杰
德真杰陈丹巴玛吕贝
古策仁杜辛效杰尊玛

en: Especially, grant all beings the good fortune to hear
The profound truth of the definitive essence,
And lift up with praise to heavenly heights
The hosts of devas, nāgas, and yakṣaswell disposed to it, O Noble Lady!

tr: dro kün nawar babpé kalzang den
dé la gawé lha lu nöjin tsok
upang gung du tö chik jetsünma
tr_zh: 杰巴额敦宁波萨莫敦
卓坤纳瓦巴贝嘎桑丹
德拉德盖韦拉鲁诺坚措
乌邦贡杜德效杰尊玛

en: In all countries, let the word “unhappiness” never be heard again,
And from the vast jewel cloud of a golden age of happiness and joy,
Filled with longevity, merit, prosperity, and devotion to the teachings,
Let a rain of all I could possibly wish for fall, O Noble Lady!

tr: gyalkham küntu mi dé mingmé ching
tsesö pal gyé ten la güpa sok
dzokden dekyi norbü trin chen lé
tr_zh: 杰康坤图米德蜜梅金
策索贝杰丹拉古巴索
佐丹德吉诺布宾陈列
多居恰巴博效杰尊玛

en: Burn the thicket of misguided thoughts and deeds
Of all humans and non-humans who inflict harm
Upon the Buddhadharma and happiness of beings
In the fires of your power, O Noble Lady!

tr: gyalwé ten dang semchen dekyi la
nampar tsewé mi dang mi mayin
samjor lokpar zhukpé tsang tsing kün
tr_zh: 杰韦丹当森坚德吉拉
南巴泽韦米当米玛因
桑觉洛巴雄贝仓清坤
图多美杰赛效杰尊玛

en: Free my mothers, infinite in number, from the fear of untimely death,
And let them spontaneously enjoy the glory of the ten virtues.
Grounded in the Three Jewels and the trainings,
Steer their course upward to liberation, O Noble Lady!

tr: khanyam ma nam dümin chi sok kyi
jikdral gé chü pal la ngang gi chö
könchok labpé zhir drok tarpa yi
tr_zh: 卡娘玛南杜敏器索吉
吉扎格居贝拉昂吉约
棍切拉贝希卓塔巴伊
卡洛根杜鸠效杰尊玛

en: Especially, don’t let me and those who depend on me
Ever fall under the sway of obstacles,
And plant the pillar of long and stable life
So that our lives and practice reach completion, O Noble Lady!

tr: khyepar dak dang dak la tö ché nam
namkün barché wang du mi drowar
tsé dang drubpa tarchin takten gyi
sok gi kawa tsuk shik jetsünma
tr_zh: 杰巴德当德拉托杰南
南坤瓦切旺杜米卓瓦
策当珠巴塔辛达丹吉
索吉嘎瓦促效杰尊玛

en: Goddess to whom I entrust my heart in this and all my future lives,
Bhagavatī, mother of all buddhas of the three times,
If you do not fulfill my aspirations,
No one else can help me, O Noble Lady!

tr: di chi küntu lo té chepé lha
dü sum gyalwé yum gyur chomden mé
mönpé drebu drubpar ma dzé na
kyab zhen dak lamé do jetsünma
tr_zh: 迪费坤图洛德杰贝拉
杜松杰韦云居尊丹梅
门贝德布珠巴玛则纳
杰贤德拉美多杰尊玛

en: You attained the inconceivable body of space
Through the power of the two accumulations gathered throughout beginningless time,
So when I supplicate you with one-pointed, fervent yearning,
Let your blessings and compassion be unconstrained, O Noble Lady!

tr: tokmé dü né tsok nyi drubpé tob
sam gyi mi khyab namkhé ku nyepé
tsechik dungwé solwa deb lak na
tr_zh: 托美杜内措尼斯贝托布
桑吉米恰纳卡古涅贝
泽吉东韦索瓦德拉纳
金拉图杰玛琼杰尊玛

en: At the center of a lotus, your body shines like the full autumn moon,
Flush with the youthful vigor of vajra bliss.
With the boundless halo of your stainless light,
Grant the four enlightened activities, O Noble Lady!

tr: chukyé ü na tön da gyepé ku
lé zhi trinlé tsol zhik jetsünma
tr_zh: 曲杰乌纳 敦达杰贝古
多杰德韦 朗措欣图佐
迪美奥吉 吉阔塔莱贝
列史陈列 索效杰尊玛

en: With your palm, formed from a hundred merits,
Which grants the supreme gift of anything one could wish for—
Dharma, wealth, sense pleasures, and liberation—to whomever it touches,
Caress my head, O Noble Lady!

tr: gangla rekpé chö nor dö dang tar
sam gu yizhin jowé chok jin gyi
chak til sönam gya lé drubpa dé
dak gi chiwor juk shik jetsünma
tr_zh: 冈拉热贝 曲诺多当塔
桑古伊辛 觉韦乔辛吉
恰替索南 加列珠巴德
德吉杰沃 纠效杰尊玛

en: From the exquisite, freshly opened lotus
Atop the precious stem between your thumb and ring finger
Drips the wish-granting honey of supreme and common siddhis.
Let it fill my mind with bliss, O Noble Lady!

tr: yi ong pema sar du zhepa lé
dak yi simpa kyé chik jetsünma
tr_zh: 特辛瓦杜 仁陈东布泽
伊昂贝玛 萨杜夏巴列
乔屯当孜 吉扬觉瓦德
德伊辛巴 杰效杰尊玛

en: Your magical appearance is graceful and charming, adorned with strings of pearls,
Small golden bells, divine garments, and ornaments,
Ablaze with the thousandfold splendor of the molten gold of sunrise.
Reveal yourself before my faithful eyes, O Noble Lady!

tr: mutik draché ser gyi dril chungchen
lhadzé gyen sok rol gek nampar trul
char khé ser zhün ziji tong barwa
depé mik ngar tön chik jetsünma
tr_zh: 穆蒂扎协 色吉迪琼坚
拉泽坚索 若杰南巴哲
恰开色雄 西吉东巴瓦
德贝米额 敦效杰尊玛

en: Sublime giver of rest in infinite pure realms,
With the stainless full moon behind you,
Seated in indestructible vajra posture,
Adorn the crown of my head, O Noble Lady!

tr: rabjam zhing na ngalso jinpé pul
chitsuk gyen du zhuk shik jetsünma
tr_zh: 热强辛纳 额索辛贝普
萨美达瓦 杰贝加约坚
米西多杰 吉莫尊吉巴
杰居坚杜 舒效杰尊玛

en: With your Brahmā voice, please teach
The profound and vast Dharma without cease,
Cut the web of the three obscurations,
And relieve us at the victorious level of awakening, O Noble Lady!

tr: chö sung tsangpé yang kyi zabpa dang
gyaché gyün mi ché tön drib sum gyi
drawa kün ché kün kyang changchub kyi
tr_zh: 曲松仓贝扬吉萨巴当
加切居米恰敦哲松吉
扎哇格杰跟江蒋曲吉
杰萨乌永索效杰尊玛

en: In short, since you are my essential refuge,
Until I reach awakening,
Never let me fall under the sway of the obstacle-maker Māra,
And grant your grace so I bring the twofold benefit to completion!

tr: dorna kyab kyi nyingpo khyö yinpé
changchub matob bar du takpar dak
barchö dü kyi wang du mi tangwar
dön nyi ta ru chinpé kadrin tsol
tr_zh: 多尔纳杰吉宁布窍银贝
江趣玛托瓦杜达巴德
瓦觉德吉旺杜米当瓦
敦涅塔鲁辛贝嘎诊索

rubric_after.en: At the age of thirty I, Yönten Gyatso,formulated this spontaneous prayer while I was severely ill, andthe country, too, was suffering from decline and degeneration.By the truth of the Three Jewels, may it be answered! Translated by Khyentse Vision Project (Heidi Nevin and Jamie Creek)

title.en: The Sweet-Sounding Song That Fulfills All Aims
title.zh: 结合根本咒之圣度母祈祷文·成办一切义之妙音

en: With OṂ the jewel of liberation and all that could be wished for is bestowed.
With the excellence of splendor, prosperity, and the like,
You bring healing to existence and peace, mistress of the three secrets,
Noble Mother of perfect generosity, to you I pay homage!

tr: om gyi tar dang dö gü nor ter
pal dang yang sok kal pa zang pö
si zhir men dzé sang wa sum dak
chok jin pak ma yum la dü do
tr_zh: 嗡吉塔当德古讷代
贝当杨索杰巴桑波
斯希 门则桑瓦松达
秋锦 帕玛 雍拉德多

rubric.en: om taré tuttaré turé soha

en: With TĀRE, the precious vessel of bodhicitta,
You constantly liberate living beings, who are in number as extensive as space,
From the ocean of suffering in cyclic existence and the lower realms.
Noble Mother Tārā, to you I pay homage!

tr: taré tuk kyé rin chen dru wö
khor wa ngen song duk ngal tso lé
kha nyam yi chen tak tu dröl wé
je tsün dröl ma yum la dü do
tr_zh: 达瑞吐杰仁钦珠沃
科瓦恩松杜额措列
卡年伊坚达图卓韦
杰尊卓玛雍拉德多

en: With TUTTĀRE, the ambrosia of blessings
Banishes the tormenting heat of fear and misery,
And causes the lotus of benefit and well-being to bloom.
To you, Mother, who protects from distress, I pay homage!

tr: tuttaré zhé jin lab dü tsi
jik ché gü pé tsa dung sal né
pen dé pe mo gye par dze pé
dung wa kyob ma yum la dü do
tr_zh: 嘟达瑞协京拉德孜
吉杰居贝察东萨内
彭德贝莫吉巴则贝
东瓦 乔玛 雍拉德多

en: TURE—the instant I remember you, Venerable One,
With your display of attributes and forms to tame beings as appropriate,
You protect against all the misfortunes of belief in a self.
I pay homage to you, compassionate and swift Mother.

tr: turé khyö zhab dren pé mö né
gang dül tsen dang ku yi köpé
dak té pong pa kün lé sung wé
tuk jé nyur ma yum la dü do
tr_zh: 嘟瑞 窍夏 坚贝莫内
刚杜灿当古宜古贝
达代彭巴滚列松韦
吐杰纽玛雍拉德多

en: SVĀHĀ—bountiful clouds of enlightened activity
Rain down jewels of virtue and goodness
That bring relief to all beings of the three realms.
I pay homage to you, Mother, Wish-fulfilling Wheel.

tr: soha trin lé dzok den trin gyi
ge lek nor bü dru char beb pé
kham sum dro kün uk jin tsöl wé
yi zhin khor lo yum la dü do
tr_zh: 梭哈琴列佐丹辛吉
给列诺布珠夏贝贝
康松卓滚吴音佐韦
伊信 科洛雍拉德多

en: In brief, to you, the embodiment of the primordial wisdom
Of all the victorious ones and their spiritual heirs,
Noble Lady, I pray with heartfelt devotion,
Take care of me until enlightenment.

tr: dor na sé ché gyal wa yong kyi
ye she chik dü pak ma khyö la
nying né güpé sol wa deb so
chang chub bar du je su zung shik
tr_zh: 多纳色杰杰瓦雍吉
益谢吉杜帕玛乔拉
宁内贵贝索瓦代索
香秋巴杜杰苏松夕

en: Pacify all circumstances that prevent the accomplishment of the sacred Dharma.
Grant your blessings that, with all favorable conditions in abundance,
Long life, merit, splendor, knowledge, and love,
I may accomplish the twofold benefit—for myself and others.

tr: dam chö drub pé gal kyen zhi zhing
tsé sö pal jor rik dang tse wé
tün kyen ma lü pün sum tsok pé
dön nyi drub par jin gyi lob shik
tr_zh: 丹曲珠贝盖坚希雄
才索贝觉利当泽韦
敦坚马吕彭松措贝
敦尼斯巴京吉洛夕

rubric_after.en: Jamyang Khyentse Wangpo, who has one-pointed, heartfelt devotion for the supreme female deity, composed this prayer. May it be accomplished accordingly!

title.en: The Excellent Bilva Tree of the Accomplishment of All Aims: Verses of Homage to the Noble Lady Tārā Wish-Fulfilling Wheel.
title.zh: 圣救度母如意轮礼赞偈·成办一切义之吉祥木橘树

en: The stainless jewel ship of your compassion
Liberates beings from the ocean of existence and peace,
Bringing them relief in the city of the heart of awakening—
O Noble Lady, Wish-Fulfilling Wheel, to you I pay homage.

tr: gang gi tugjé düldral rinchen drü
si dang zhiwé chuter lé dral né
jangchub nyingpö drong du uk jinpé
tr_zh: 刚各吐杰杜扎仁钦久
深当协威趣得莱扎呢
降洽宁波滚图乌敬贝
帕玛益喜科洛强擦洛

rubric.en: Namo Āryā Tārāye

en: The mere appearance in my mind of the moonlight of your marks and signs,
That finest essence churned from the ocean of the two accumulations,
Grants the easeful rest of longevity and wisdom—
O Noble Lady, Wish-Fulfilling Wheel, to you I pay homage.

tr: tsok zung gyatso subpé nyingpö pül
tsenpé danang yi la shar tsam gyi
tsé dang yeshé ngal tso ter dzepé
tr_zh: 措松嘉措顺贝宁波普
灿贝达囊益拉霞赞杰
策当益协嘎措得泽贝
帕玛益申科洛强擦洛

en: From the single beryl lute of your secret speech,
Music from the ocean of melodious sounds
Appears to all in a melody of a million gathered teachings—
O Noble Lady, Wish-Fulfilling Wheel, to you I pay homage.

tr: sung sang baidur gyümang chigpu lé
yang kyi yenlak gyatsö rölmo ni
chöpung jewé dang su yong sharwa
tr_zh: 松桑贝杜居芒吉布拉
央吉雁拉嘉措瑞莫呢
却彭杰威当苏勇夏瓦
帕玛益申科洛强擦洛

en: Your mind is the non-dual union of wisdom and basic space,
In which any stirring of the constructs of grasper and grasped has been stilled,
And yet the majesty of your knowledge and love is infinite—
O Noble Lady, Wish-Fulfilling Wheel, to you I pay homage.

tr: gang tuk nyi su mepé yeshé ying
zungdzin tröpé juk dang tül gyur kyang
rik dang tsewé ziji tayé pa
tr_zh: 刚吐尼苏美贝益协英
松怎绰贝橘当德居江
热当贼威西结塔亚贝
帕巴益申科洛强擦洛

en: Sublime mother, in your mesmerizing display
Of the sixty-four inexhaustible qualities of freedom and ripening,
You unsteady even the victors and their heirs—
O Noble Lady, Wish-Fulfilling Wheel, to you I pay homage.

tr: yönten drugchu tsa zhi gek changwé
sé ché gyal kün tenpa trogpé yum
tr_zh: 扎当南巴敏巴弥扎贝
云敦珠久扎协格香贝
瑟杰加根丹巴绰贝尤
帕玛益申科洛强擦洛

en: In a continuous stream, pervading all of space,
Your spontaneous and effortless activity,
Like a wish-granting tree, answers the hopes of those to be tamed—
O Noble Lady, Wish-Fulfilling Wheel, to you I pay homage.

tr: gyün gyi tak ching kha tar khyabpa dang
lhündrub du mi dzepé trinlé kyi
düljé rewa kong dzé pagsam wang
tr_zh: 居吉达江卡塔恰巴当
伦珠多弥泽贝钦莱吉
度夏热瓦孔泽巴桑旺
帕玛益申科洛强擦洛

en: In short, to fully accomplish the sworn resolve
Of all those who enjoy mastery over the ten powers,
You perform unimaginable deeds to tame living beings—
O Noble Lady, Wish-Fulfilling Wheel, to you I pay homage.

tr: dorna tob chu ngawa tamché kyi
dro dül dzepa sam gyi mi khyabpé
tr_zh: 多那 托久 昂瓦 塔杰吉
图杰 丹恰 永素 佐巴 奇
卓度 匝巴 桑吉 米恰贝
帕玛 伊辛 阔洛 恰擦洛

en: Thus, in devotion I pay homage and supplicate you—
Grant your blessings so that your wisdom insight, like the great clouds of the perfect age,
Showers down a gentle rain of all desired siddhis,
Spreading an abundant feast of joy and benefit.

tr: yeshé zigpé dzok den trinchen lé
pendé gatön gyepar jin gyi lob
tr_zh: 得达古贝强擦索得纳
益协西贝若丹灵千莱
欧珠多古杜恰热耀韦
潘德噶敦杰巴宾吉洛

rubric_after.en: For the sake of Gyurme Namdak, one whose expansive vision is rich with insight, Jamyang Khyentse Wangpo composed an auspicious number of verses in homage and supplication to the Noble Lady, Moon of Compassion.

title.en: Words of Auspiciousness to Accomplish One’s Aims
title.zh: 至尊度母礼赞·成就所愿之吉祥偈

en: By merely hearing your name,
Beings are freed from saṃsāra’s ocean.
Enraptured by this wondrous miracle,
I supplicate you with total devotion.

tr: khyö tsen tö pa tsam gyi kyang
dro nam khor tso lé dröl wé
ngo tsar kho nar yi chak pé
tsé chik gü pé söl deb na
tr_zh: 切灿托巴灿吉扬
卓南科措列卓韦
昂擦科纳益恰贝
则吉贵贝索代那

rubric.en: Namastāraye!

en: Your gorgeous form is adorned with virtuous marks,
Like millions of powdered emeralds piled up high.
May you display this splendid form before my eyes,
With a hundred peacefully smiling expressions.

tr: rab dzé ma gé jé wé dül
chik tu pung pé gé tsen chen
dzé ku dak gi mik lam du
zhi dzum nyam gyé röl par dzö
tr_zh: 拉杰玛噶杰韦杜
吉图蓬贝给灿坚
杰库达吉米兰杜
希尊年杰若巴则

en: From the accomplishment of your secret vidyā mantra,
An ocean of precious treasures,
Siddhis, both mundane and supramundane, well forth.
Thus, may you grant benefit and bliss throughout the three planes.

tr: jik ten jik ten dé pa yi
ngö drub rin chen gya tsö yik
rik pé sang ngak drub pa lé
sa sum pen dé jin gyur chik
tr_zh: 吉定吉定代巴义
欧珠仁钦嘉措益
利贝桑昂珠巴列
萨松彭德锦久吉

en: Basic space is profound and sublime peace.
It is free of directions and parts.
When bestowing your blessings, at that very moment,
Make duality dissolve into the central channel!

tr: zab ching chok tu zhi wé ying
chok dang cha lé nam dröl wé
jin gyi lab pé ké chik la
zung dzin u mar tim dzé söl
tr_zh: 萨金秋图希韦英
秋当恰列南卓贝
京吉拉贝盖吉拉
松真乌玛廷则索

en: Most especially, for all of us living in dread of the decline
Of these dark and degenerate times,
Mother of All Victors, day and night I turn to you.
I know no other protection than you.

tr: khyé par nyik lé cher nyik pé
dü kyi gü pé rab trak nam
nyin tsen mé par gyal wé yum
khyö lé kyab zhen sem pa dral
tr_zh: 切巴年列切年贝
迪吉古贝拉扎南
宁灿美巴杰韦雍
乔列迦显森巴扎

en: So, extend your hand of compassion,
Dispel all my fears,
And grant me the bountiful fortune
Of finding relief in a perfect realm.

tr: dé lé tuk jé chak kyang né
jik pa ta dak sal wa dang
kün gé né su uk yung wé
kal pa zang po drub par dzö
tr_zh: 代莱吐杰恰强内
吉巴塔达萨瓦当
贡盖内苏乌永韦
杰巴桑波珠巴则

en: In the meantime, I beseech you, make the qualities of the four perfections
Blossom with blazing beauty,
And laden with such abundance,
The indivisible three kāyas are ultimately unified.

tr: lar la né kab dé zhi yi
yön ten mé tok dzé bar war
tar tuk ku sum mi ché pé
zung juk nyé ma dü dzé söl
tr_zh: 拉拉内卡代希义
云丹美托杰巴瓦
塔图古松米切贝
松纠涅玛杜则索

en: In short, from now until awakening,
May I remain forever
Under Noble Tārā’s joyful gaze,
And thus may the beautiful picture of all desired aims be perfected.

tr: dor na di né jang chub bar
pak ma gyé pé chen zur dang
nam yang mi dral drok pa lé
dö gü ré kha dzok gyur chik
tr_zh: 多纳迪内香秋巴
帕玛杰贝坚萨当
南扬米扎多巴列
德古热卡佐久吉

rubric_after.en: These small flowers of auspicious supplication were scattered by the vidyādhara Mañjughoṣa to grant some relief to those living in dread of the decline of these dark times. Grant your blessings that these aspirations be fulfilled! Sarvadā śreyo bhavatu.

title.en: The Sage's Powerful Words of Truth: A Prayer for the Spread of the Omniscient Buddha's Teachings
title.zh: 遍知能仁教法兴盛之愿文-仙人真言

en: Among the thousand buddhas of this fortunate age,
You are the most wondrous and majestic, as rare as an _uḍumbara_ flower,
You who care for our world during this age of conflict,
Mighty sage, Siddhārtha, to you I pay homage!

tr: ngotsar u dum wa ra tar pak shing
tsöpé dü dir zhingkham yong zungwa
tub chok dön kün drub la chaktsal lo
tr_zh: 刚让桑杰朵列切巴杜
俄灿乌夺瓦然达帕西
座冰杜得谢康永索瓦
徒琼豆葛竹拉恰曹罗

rubric.en: Homage to the guru and all the buddhas and bodhisattvas!

en: All you buddhas, bodhisattvas, śrāvakas and pratyekabuddhas in all directions,
Great bodhisattvas, Mañjuśrī, Avalokiteśvara,
Vajrapāṇi, Maitreya and the rest,
Together with the sixteen sthaviras and seven great patriarchs,

tr: chok chü sangye changsem nyenrang dang
jamyang chenzik chak na dorjé dzin
neten chudruk té rab chenpo dün
tr_zh: 琼劲桑杰甲生涅让铛
将央届僧袷那多杰遮
降巴拉索奖秋达巴铛
涅登介著灯饶切布刀

en: Six ornaments and two supreme ones of this world, the two marvellous ācāryas,
Eighty-four mahāsiddhas, and the rest,
And especially, the Lotus-born Guru, whose kindness is beyond compare,
Śāntarakṣita, Tri Songdetsen, Vairotsana and Atiśa,

tr: dzamling gyen chok mejung lobpön ché
naljor wangchuk gyechu tsa zhi sok
tr_zh: 藏林杰琼灭迥洛布企
囊迥旺秋加久藏系梭
切巴噶正娘灭贝玛囧
息措彻颂贝若阿底峡

en: Five Sakya Patriarchs, Marpa, Milarepa and Gampopa,
Lama Tsongkhapa, Mañjughoṣa in person, and all the rest,
All you great learned and accomplished vidyādharas of India and Tibet,
And all you peaceful and wrathful _yidam_ deities, ḍākinīs and dharmapālas—
We invoke you! Turn your wisdom minds towards us, and look upon us with compassion!
zh: 蔣揚喇嘛(宗喀巴)等印度西藏

tr: gongma nam nga mar mi dakpo jé
jamyang lama lasok gya bö kyi
khé dang drubpé rigdzin tsok nam dang
tukdam né né kul lo tukjé gong
tr_zh: 宫玛囊昂玛媒搭波杰
降央喇嘛拉索甲博偈
肯铛著冰仁哲崇囊铛
英达喜戳康珠曲冋梭
徒达涅列古螺土杰供

en: All the teachings of the Buddha—Vinaya, Sūtra, Abhidharma,
The four classes of tantra within the Secret Mantra,
The teachings of the ten great pillars of the study lineage in the Land of Snows,
And the eight great chariots of the practice lineage,
All the sūtra and mantra traditions of the Buddha’s teachings—
Look now and see the extent to which they have all declined!

tr: sang ngak gyüdé chenpo nampa zhi
gangjong shé gyü ka chen chupo dang
tubten do dang ngak kyi tsul tadak
shintu nyampar gyurpa di la zik
tr_zh: 土登督瓦驮灯俄巴铛
桑昂解灯且布囊巴习
刚冋谢久嘎茄久部戏
著旧戏达切戒拉索巴
图登朵达昂偈初坛搭
胁独年巴玖巴德拉盛

en: The saffron-robed saṅgha, upholders of the victory banner of discipline and renunciation,
Bodhisattvas who, without pretense or deception, genuinely seek to benefit others,
And holders of awareness mantras who maintain the commitments, and practise generation and completion—
Look how these practitioners have been reduced to pale imitations of the real thing, like a mere drawing of a butter lamp!
Look upon us now with your eyes of wisdom, and care for us in your compassion, we pray!
Beings of this evil age with its five degenerations,

tr: damtsik den zhing kyedzok rik ngak chang
gyurpa di la yeshe chenden nam
ngepar gong la tukjé kyab tu sol
tr_zh: 皑冋尺橙俄秘降彩拖
协鹏缩玫奖秋胜巴铛
丹测邓喜揭佐仁昂袷
曾宁灯巴热幕芒魅旦
鸠巴德拉英谢借登囊
皑巴功拉图杰角独艘

en: Are caught in the bonds of turbulent and destructive emotions, their cravings and desires.
The followers of the teachings fight amongst themselves,
Spurred on by the fierce winds of jealousy,
And degenerate views are widespread.

tr: dü ngen nyikma nga dö semchen nam
nyönmong tob drak dö sé chingwé ching
ten la zhuk nam trakdok lungmar gyi
tenpa nang truk tawé nyikma gyé
tr_zh: 独挨宁玛昂夺僧界囊
忸莫朵咋朵深青外精
灯拉秀囊察东龙曼偈
登巴纳朱弹外宁玛皆

en: Through these defilements, brought about by conflicts within the tradition,
The Dharma protectors, guardians of all that is positive, have turned away from us,
While warrior-like _asuras_ and barbarians fill the world—
In these and other ways, the teachings have declined.

tr: tsöpachen du gyurpé ten sel gyi
drib kyi chökyong karchok sungma yel
di dang didrar gyurpé tenpa nub
tr_zh: 枣巴揭独玖倍登绅偈
止己曲鹫嘎琼梭玛耶
加康各独拉密浪龙凯
德铛德站玖倍登巴留

en: _Kyema Kyihü_! O compassionate protectors!
Increase the power and strength of your sacred commitments!
Why would you be discouraged by the sadness of these evil times?

tr: kyema kyi hü gönpo tukjé chen
khyö nam tukdam tutsal tob kyé la
dü ngen kyowé zhumpa chi la nga
tr_zh: 界玛偈火功布图杰精
趋囊图旦凸糌栋借拉
督唉鸠外休巴机拉昂

en: Since you are masters of the ten strengths and possessors of the ten powers,
You must surely heal and restore the teachings.
Send us genuine teachers who are learned, disciplined and accomplished,
To breathe fresh life into the Buddhadharma!

tr: tob chü wangchuk wang chu ngawé na
khé tsün drubtob tsemar gyurpa ni
mangpor trul né tenpa sowar dzö
tr_zh: 朵介旺丘王介昂外那
登巴年巴德荡梭邱巾
科主竹陀乘玛玖巴呢
玛布竹涅登巴索丸仲

en: In both India and Tibet, may the precious lamps of joyful celebration,
Be set ablaze, to usher in another golden age,
And may the non-sectarian, lotus-like teachings of the Buddha, flourish and blossom.

tr: pak bö nyi su dzokden chima yi
gyalten rimé petsal dar la bab
tr_zh: 帕博尼色宗跌茄玛英
岗朵仁钦卓枚伴瓦铛
迦登仁美贝灿弹拉宝

en: May the minds of those who harbour ill-will towards the teachings be changed,
And filled with inspiration to practise the ten virtuous actions.
May the saṅgha, the holders of the teachings, fill this world of ours,
And study and practice increase and spread.

tr: dé la khuwé tsok kyi sem gyur zhing
kün kyang ten la dün dang gé chur chö
tendzin gendün dé yi dzamling khyab
shé dang drubpa dar zhing gyepar shok
tr_zh: 蝶拉客歪崇偈僧解喜
戈跏灯拉德铛埂救究
登哲更得戴赢赞林千
谢铛竹巴档喜杰巴秀

en: May vast clouds of offerings fill all monasteries and temples,
And the great drum of the Dharma resound far and wide,
Annihilating the deluded arguments of the _tīrthikas_,
And sounding the victory of the Buddhadharma in all directions.

tr: tsuklakhang nam chöpé trin tsok gyé
dampé chö kyi nga chen rabtu drok
mutek langpö lepa gem jé ching
tubten chok lé nampar gyal gyur chik
tr_zh: 众拉康囊曲冰珍崇杰
丹冰曲偈昂切绕杜倬
目灯浪部赖巴庚解己
土登冋类纳巴降玖偈

en: May the lives of all the holders of the teachings be secure,
And may the lives and merits of benefactors increase,
May even the names of those who would harm the teachings disappear,
And may the victory banner of the teachings be raised in all directions!

tr: tendzin kyé nam zhabpé tenpa dang
tenpé jindak tsé dang sönam pel
ten la nö nam ming gi lhakmar gyur
tenpé gyaltsen chok chur dreng gyur chik
tr_zh: 登泽解囊侠贝灯巴铛
登冰景达才铛索浪佩
登拉诺囊蜜耿廊玛玖
登冰加泽冋解珍久吉

rubric_after.en: Chökyi Lodrö wrote down whatever came to mind at the foot of the bodhi tree in Vajrāsana (Bodhgayā) in the noble land of India. May these words be blessed so that they all come true. Sarvadā maṅgalaṃ! Translated by Adam Pearcey, 2007.

en: Lord of the ocean of the non-sectarian teachings of the Land of Snows,
Wondrous one who turned the wheel of the seven transmissions,
Khyentse Wangpo, Manjushri in person—
May your tradition and teachings spread and flourish—may there be auspiciousness!

tr: gang jong rimé tenpa gyatsö dak
jampal yang ngö khyentsé wangpo yi
tr_zh: 岗迥日美旦巴杰措达
鄂擦卡巴敦吉科罗杰
绛巴央俄钦则旺波义
仁卢旦巴达杰扎西秀

en: The deathless, accomplished vidyadhara Vimala’s
Magical dance of the wisdom vajra of the three secrets—
Chökyi Lodrö, Manjushri in person—
May your teachings spread and increase—may there be auspiciousness!

tr: sang sum yeshé dorjé gyutrül gar
jampal yang ngö chökyi lodrö kyi
tenpa dar zhing gyépé trashi shok
tr_zh: 其美珠贝日怎比玛莱
桑松耶西多杰焦川嘎
绛巴央俄曲吉罗珠吉
旦巴达津杰贝扎西秀

en: Magical dance of the wisdom of Khyentse Wangpo,
Chökyi Lodrö, emanation body of the three secrets,
Jamyang Thupten Chökyi Gyatso—
May your lotus feet remain firm and your activity increase!

tr: chökyi lodrö sang sum trülpé ku
tr_zh: 钦哲旺波耶西焦川嘎
曲吉罗珠桑松珠贝古
绛央土登曲吉嘉措义
夏贝丹锦赤雷杰居吉

rubric.en: Thus, aspirations and auspicious verses such as these, connected with the occasion, should be widely extended as appropriate, for well-being.

en: In all my lifetimes,
May I carry the great burden of the teachings.
Even if I am unable to carry that great burden,
The worry that the teachings may decline—
May at least a little of it weigh on my mind.

tr: sem trel tsam yang jungwar shok
tr_zh: 达尼界瓦弹皆杜
登比科切科瓦秀
科切科瓦玛柳降
登巴年偈多巴英
索成章杨迥瓦秀

rubric.en: Composed by Khenchen Kunga Wangchuk.

rubric_after.en: The words of the omniscient Dolpopa.
